Welcome to our website. We hope it provides you with the information you need about St Joesph's Catholic Primary School in Thame.
St Joseph's is a warm and vibrant school that offers a broad and balanced education to children aged 4-11 years from the local community, and this warmth was recognised by Ofsted in their visit to the school earlier this year. They noted that:

If you are looking to choose a school for your child, please see the wide range of information on this website, but do not hesitate to make an appointment to visit the school and meet us.
The school is part of the Parish of St Joseph's Thame, and the strong relationship between parish and school adds considerably to the caring and inclusive ethos.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Joseph's Catholic Primary School - Attendance
pageCache.text:
Attendance
Attendance
A letter from our Governors:
As Governors we work with our school leaders to ensure St Joseph’s is a school where children can thrive and be, “inspired to be our best “. It is part of our duty as Governors to give strategic direction, monitor and plan to secure good attendance in our school and to promote an ethos of good attendance. Unfortunately, attendance and punctuality at our school are causing real concern. We understand that the past few years have had a real impact on school attendance but, now that we have returned to normal, it is more important than ever that children are in school to redress the balance in all areas of their education. We do appreciate children need to be kept off school when they are genuinely sick; however, there are currently too many children who have poor attendance rates. Poor attendance and late arrivals not only affects the child who is not in school but all the other children in the class too.
We are obliged to consider 90% attendance as “PERSISTENT ABSENCE”
Please help you child and us by considering the following :
It is our belief that good attendance and punctuality are not only fundamental to a child’s progress but develop good habits and skills which lead to success later in life. We are committed to working in partnership with parents and to supporting you in your aspirations for your children’s education so we look forward to your support with this.
Thank you in anticipation of your support in this important matter.
Local Governing Body (Governors)

pageCache.text:
Wrap-around care and Clubs
Extra-Curricular Activities at St Joseph’s
At St Joseph’s, we are proud to offer a wide range of exciting extra-curricular activities that take place during the school day, at lunchtime, and after school. These opportunities allow children to explore their interests, develop new skills, and enjoy learning beyond the classroom.
We offer music lessons through Oxfordshire Music Service and Rock Steady, giving children the chance to discover their musical talents and perform with confidence.
Throughout the school year, we also run a variety of after-school activity clubs, organised by specialist external providers. The clubs available may change each term, offering children the chance to try something new. Here’s a flavour of what’s on offer:
Street Dance – Monday after school
Sports Club – Tuesday after school
Choir- Lunchtime club. Scroll and click the Choir page link below for information on upcoming dates, events and track links for the Thame Festival of Christmas Music.
Various Sports Clubs – offered throughout the year
Creation Station Art Club – Thursday after school
If you would like more information about any of our clubs or how to register, please contact the school office.
Please see the pages below for more specific information .

pageCache.pageTitle: St Joseph's Catholic Primary School - Modern Foreign Languages
pageCache.text:
Modern Foreign Languages
At St Joseph's Catholic Primary School, our languages curriculum provides our Key Stage 2 children with a strong foundation in French, so that they can go on to communicate with confidence and competence in this language. We believe that learning a second language is essential for our students' personal and academic growth, and it opens up a world of opportunities for them in the future. We have chosen to use the Language Angels programme as it provides comprehensive support for teachers in delivering the French curriculum and includes engaging resources that will capture the attention of our young learners.
Our aim is to ensure that through learning an additional language, our children will develop an appreciation and understanding of another culture outside of the UK, as well as an appreciation for the importance of language learning in today's interconnected world. We will achieve this by providing a range of stimulating and interactive learning experiences, which will enable our students to develop their speaking, listening, reading and writing skills in French.
We want our children to leave St Joseph's with a solid foundation in French and a love for language learning that will stay with them for life. We believe that by providing a high-quality language education, we are equipping our students with the skills and knowledge they need to succeed in a globalised world and to become responsible and engaged citizens of the future.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Joseph's Catholic Primary School - Personal, Social and Health Education
pageCache.text:
Personal, Social and Health Education
At St Joseph's Catholic Primary School, our primary goal is to ensure the holistic development of our pupils. We believe that education goes beyond the academic curriculum, and that is why we have implemented a robust Personal, Social and Health Education (PSHE) programme. Our PSHE curriculum is designed to support the social and emotional growth of our students and help them become responsible and caring individuals.
We recognise that each child is unique, and our PSHE programme is tailored to meet the individual needs of our students. We structure and plan our curriculum with the help of the Dimensions 3D PSHE Programme: a thoughtful and engaging platform that provides our students with the knowledge and skills they need to navigate the challenges they will face in life. Through the programme, our students will learn about topics such as relationships, health and wellbeing, and personal finance.
At St Joseph's, we believe that PSHE is essential in shaping our children into well-rounded individuals. We provide our pupils with the tools they need to succeed both in and out of the classroom and for their future challenges and celebrations.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Joseph's Catholic Primary School - Religious Education
pageCache.text:
Religious Education
At St Joseph's Catholic Primary School, we are dedicated to providing a high-quality Religious Education curriculum that promotes the teachings of the Catholic faith and supports the spiritual and moral development of our pupils. We ensure that they develop a deep understanding of the Catholic Faith and are equipped with the knowledge, skills, and values needed to live their lives as faithful, compassionate, and responsible members of their communities.
We recognise the importance of creating a nurturing and inclusive learning environment where all children feel valued and respected, whatever their background or beliefs. Our RE curriculum aims to promote respect, understanding, and tolerance of different faiths and cultures while celebrating the rich traditions and teachings of the Catholic Faith.
We inspire our students to become lifelong learners and disciples of Christ who are committed to living out the values of the Catholic Faith in all aspects of their lives. We believe that by providing a high-quality RE curriculum that is rooted in the teachings of the Catholic Church, we can help our children to develop a strong sense of purpose, meaning, and direction in their lives and make a positive difference to the world around them.
At St. Joseph's Catholic Primary School, our RE curriculum is based on the Archdiocese of Birmingham's 'Learning and Growing as the People of God' document, which provides a comprehensive framework for the teaching and learning of the Catholic Faith. This is central to our school's mission and values, and we are committed to fostering a deep sense of spirituality and a strong Catholic identity in our students.
Our curriculum is designed to be engaging, challenging, and relevant to the lives of our children. We aim to provide a rich and varied learning experience that includes a range of teaching methods and resources, including digital technology, visual aids, and hands-on activities. Our curriculum also includes opportunities for pupils to participate in liturgical celebrations, events and ceremonies, which help them to deepen their faith and put it into action.
The RE curriculum is a collaboration between school, home, and parish and a focus on our school mission statement underpins all that we do at St. Joseph's school, and is the essence of our Catholic Education.
